_note: Small demo list of well-known CVEs. Descriptions and version ranges are simplified for learning. Check the real details on the NVD website (nvd.nist.gov) before the final project. min_version and max_version are both included in the range. If min_version is missing, the range has no lower limit.

vulnerabilities.description: Path traversal flaw that lets an attacker read files outside the web folder.
Flaw in the proxy module that lets an attacker make the server send requests to other machines.
Lets an attacker upload a file and make the server run it.
A privileged user can make the database server hang or crash.
Memory flaw in Office that can run attacker code when a bad document is opened.
Zerologon: lets an attacker take over the domain controller without a password.
Flaw in file sharing (SMB) compression that lets an attacker run code remotely.
Log4Shell: a logged text message can make the application download and run attacker code.
Lets an attacker find out which user names exist on the server.
